subject: gk
question:
Select the correct sequence of the following steps during the process of photosynthesis.

i. Chlorophyll helps in absorbing light energy.

ii. Light energy is converted into chemical energy and the water molecule is split into oxygen and hydrogen molecules.

iii. Carbon dioxide is converted into carbohydrates.

options.text: Step i and step ii always occur together and step iii can occur any other time
They always occur sequentially in the order i −> ii −> iii
Step i occurs first and steps ii and iii occur together next
These steps need not occur one after another immediately

solution:
The correct answer is __**They always occur sequentially in the order i -> ii -> iii**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• During photosynthesis, light energy is first absorbed by chlorophyll in the chloroplasts, initiating the process.
 
• The absorbed light energy is then converted into chemical energy, leading to the splitting of water molecules into oxygen and hydrogen.
 
• Oxygen is released as a by-product of the splitting of water molecules.
 
• The hydrogen molecules are used in the Calvin cycle to convert carbon dioxide into carbohydrates.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Chlorophyll:** A green pigment found in the chloroplasts of plants, algae, and cyanobacteria, responsible for the absorption of light energy during photosynthesis.
 
• **Calvin Cycle:** Also known as the light-independent reactions or dark reactions, this cycle uses ATP and NADPH produced in the light-dependent reactions to fix carbon dioxide into carbohydrates.
 
• **Photosystems:** Complexes of chlorophyll and proteins in the thylakoid membranes of chloroplasts that play a crucial role in the light-dependent reactions of photosynthesis.
 
• **ATP and NADPH:** These are energy carriers produced during the light-dependent reactions and are used in the Calvin cycle to synthesize carbohydrates.
 
• **Stomata:** Small openings on the surface of leaves that allow the exchange of gases (CO₂ and O₂) necessary for photosynthesis.
